Smt.Mintu Jose Respondent/S: 1 The Adjudicating Officer And Sub Collector Kozhikode, Pin - 673001 Rasheed M vs The Adjudicating Officer And Sub ... on 17 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/56811548/ 1 2 The Food Safety Officer Kozhikode North Circle, Pin - 673001 3 The Revenue Divisional Officer Kozhikode, Pin - 673001 4 The Food Safety Commissioner Commissionerate Of Food Safety , Government Of Kerala, Pin - 695001 Wp(C) No.33715 Of 2024 2 2026:Ker:14238 5 The Principal Government Medical College, Medical College Junction, Mavoor Road, Kozhikode, Pin - 673008 By Adv. Gp - Smt. Preetha K K
texts.facts: Issue a writ of mandamus directing the 2nd respondent or the competent among the respondents to issue registration U/Sec.31(2) of the Act. iv. Issue a writ of mandamus directing the respondents 2 and 4 to consider issuance of FSSAI License to the 2nd petitioner without insisting for a No Objection Certificate from the Principal, Medical College, Kozhikode. v. Issue any other order, or direction, this Honourable Court deems fit to grant under the fact and circumstances of this case." [SIC] WP(C) NO.33715 OF 2024 2026:KER:14238 2. The grievance of the petitioners is that, even though an application was submitted for license as evident by Ext.P8 receipt, the same was not considered for want of consent from the 5th respondent.
